sentiment.label: neutral
sentiment.reason_it: I mercati asiatici hanno chiuso in positivo, con il Nikkei che è balzato del 2.87%. Il sentiment è neutrale in quanto il VIX è sceso a 16.70 e l'S&P 500 ha guadagnato lo 0.37%. Tuttavia, la situazione geopolitica tra USA e Iran rimane tesa, con possibili ripercussioni sul prezzo del petrolio. I report istituzionali di BlackRock e Goldman Sachs suggeriscono una visione cauta ma non allarmistica.
sentiment.reason_en: Asian markets closed positively, with Nikkei surging 2.87%. The sentiment is neutral as VIX decreased to 16.70 and S&P 500 gained 0.37%. However, the geopolitical situation between the US and Iran remains tense, with potential repercussions on oil prices. Institutional reports from BlackRock and Goldman Sachs suggest a cautious but not alarming view.

market_impact_summary.it: Il mercato azionario asiatico ha performato positivamente, con il Nikkei che è salito del 2.87%. L'indice DXY è sceso dello 0.34%, mentre il prezzo del petrolio è sceso del 3.22%. I tassi di interesse sono risultati stabili, con il TLT che è salito dello 0.55%. I report di BlackRock e Goldman Sachs indicano una visione positiva sul mercato, ma con una certa cautela.
market_impact_summary.en: The Asian stock market performed positively, with Nikkei rising 2.87%. The DXY index decreased by 0.34%, while oil prices fell by 3.22%. Interest rates were stable, with TLT up 0.55%. BlackRock and Goldman Sachs reports indicate a positive view on the market, but with some caution.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.


Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo del 2.87%, Shanghai in rialzo dello 0.96%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura positiva per i mercati europei.


Sul fronte dei mercati occidentali, l'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.37%, il VIX è in calo dello 0.36%, segnale di propensione al rischio. Il Dollar Index è in calo dello 0.34%, mentre l'oro è pressoché invariato sopra i 4523 dollari l'oncia. Il petrolio Brent è in calo del 3.22% sotto i 100 dollari. Il rendimento del decennale USA è in calo dello 0.61% al 4.55%, mentre il BTP 10Y italiano è stabile al 3.73%.


In geopolitica, le trattative sull'Iran potrebbero avere ricadute sul prezzo del petrolio, con possibili aumenti dei costi energetici.


Sul fronte macro, nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin si mantiene sopra i settantasettemila dollari, con una variazione del +0,82% nella giornata di oggi. Tuttavia, i flussi ETF hanno registrato una significativa uscita di 105,2 milioni di dollari. Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalle recenti dichiarazioni sul futuro della politica monetaria. Inoltre, Bitcoin continua ad essere soggetto a pressioni, nonostante il sostegno di figure come Kevin Warsh, recentemente indicato come potenziale presidente della Fed. 

  Sul fronte delle altcoin, Ethereum scende leggermente a duemilacentodiciassette dollari con un calo dell'0,18%, mentre Solana perde lo 0,75% a ottantacinque dollari e novantadue centesimi. BNB invece guadagna lo 0,43% arrivando a seicentosessantuno dollari e ottantasette centesimi.

  Il Fear & Greed Index si attesta a 30, in zona Fear, suggerisce cautela tra gli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The Nikkei closed up 2.87%, Shanghai up 0.96%, suggesting a positive opening for European markets. In Western markets, the S&P 500 closed up 0.37%, the VIX down 0.36%, a sign of risk appetite. The Dollar Index is down 0.34%, while gold is essentially flat above $4,523 per ounce. Brent crude oil is down 3.22% below $100 The 10-year US yield is down 0.61% to 4.55%, while the Italian 10Y BTP is stable at 3.73%. In geopolitics, Iran talks could impact oil prices, with possible increases in energy costs. On the macro front, no major data releases today. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... Bitcoin holds above $77,000, up 0.82% today. However, ETF flows saw a significant outflow of $105.2 million. This move may be influenced by recent statements on future monetary policy. Bitcoin continues to face pressure, despite support from figures like Kevin Warsh, recently mentioned as a potential Fed chairman. Among altcoins, Ethereum slightly down to $2,017, down 0.18%, while Solana loses 0.75% to $85.92 BNB gains 0.43% to $661.87 The Fear & Greed Index stands at 30, in Fear zone, suggesting caution among investors. No macro data on the agenda today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thanks for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: What does it mean to be "European" today?
articles.snippet: The idea of Europe as a community emerged many centuries ago, but its meaning keeps changing—to Europeans and non-Europeans alike. Juliet Johnson has pioneered research on the changing role of European symbols such as the 12-starred flag, designed in the 1950s and formally adopted by European institutions in the 1980s. Intriguingly, shifts in meaning have often first occurred on Europe's eastern side, before being adopted by Europe's western "core." What does it mean to be European today, in a fast-changing geopolitical environment and amid debates on which new member countries the European…

articles.title: With oil markets nearing the danger zone, a US-Iran deal can’t come soon enough | Heather Stewart
articles.snippet: Global prices are approaching a tipping point that could trigger inflation, shortages and, over time, recession If a US-Iran deal is about to be reached, three months on from the launch of Donald Trump’s Operation Epic Fury, it will not be a day too soon for oil markets, which are approaching a dangerous tipping point. The cost of a barrel of crude on the spot market – for immediate purchase, effectively – has bounced about $100 since Iran predictably responded to the onslaught from the US and Israel by closing the strait of Hormuz. Continue reading...

articles.title: Rubio Plays Down Imminent U.S.-Iran Deal
articles.snippet: The U.S. will deal with Iran “another way” if it does not reach a good deal with the Islamic Republic, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday, playing down hopes that an agreement is imminent. Following signals from Washington during the weekend that the U.S. and Iran could be nearing a framework agreement, oil prices plunged on Monday in Asian trade, with Brent Crude prices slipping below the $100 per barrel mark. However, losses were being contained at about 3-4% in the morning in Europe as the market hopes for a deal…

articles.title: Australia’s LNG Industry Warns Policy Uncertainty Is Hurting Investment
articles.snippet: Australia’s energy producers are calling for state and federal support in faster approvals of new projects and fiscal stability. These could help the world’s third-biggest LNG exporter grow its overseas markets amid the expected years-long turmoil in the global gas market in the wake of the Iran war. Producers want long-term predictability in taxation, as well as faster permitting processes and environmental reviews from the state and federal governments. As a whole, the industry seeks clarity and certainty that would incentivize producers…
